gunshot.ar.near.notes: AR-15 96 kHz near takes (-03/-04 are pitched-up AK/Marlin singles, the AR disc holds only two clean shots); 5-8 ms raised-cosine soft attack, +4.5-6.5 dB @255-275 Hz body, -9 dB @2.6 kHz, cascaded 5.8 kHz lowpass, parallel >7 kHz air send at 0.023-0.036, 1.5 s dark plate at 22-30% wet. Round-robin 4, level trimmed 0/-0.9/-0.4/-1.3 dB.

gunshot.ak.near.notes: Four isolated AK-47 near singles pitched 0.90-0.965; lowest body centre (200-235 Hz), 5.2 kHz main lowpass and the longest near tail of the rifles (1.8 s plate, 28-36% wet).

gunshot.smg.near.notes: Carl Gustav M45 + PPSh pitched up 1.06-1.15, shortest slice (1.1 s), 6.2 kHz lowpass and the driest tail (20-25% wet) — fast and small, still soft-attacked at 4-6 ms.

gunshot.sniper.near.notes: Mosin Nagant + Marlin 336 pitched down to 0.85-0.905, 4.8 kHz lowpass and the heaviest air send (0.041-0.045); 2.4 s plate at 40-48% wet gives the cinematic bloom without any crack.

gunshot.ar.distant.notes: Other-player / across-map AR. 24 ms attack swell, -15 dB @2.7 kHz, main band lowpassed to 3.4 kHz with a separate >7.2 kHz air send at 0.027 — distance loses the crack but keeps a sheen of air; 62% wet on a 2.8 s tail.

gunshot.ak.distant.notes: As above, main band at 3.0 kHz / 66% wet on a 3.1 s tail — the softest thump of the four; this is what a firefight of twenty AKs sounds like.

gunshot.smg.distant.notes: Main band at 3.6 kHz / 58% wet; the brightest of the distants so full-auto chatter still reads at range.

gunshot.sniper.distant.notes: 32 ms swell, main band at 2.6 kHz, 70% wet, 3.6 s tail — a rolling boom across the valley.

reload.magout.notes: Stage 1/3. Onset-sliced from assaultriflereload1 / handgun-reload-zer0sol, close-mic'd: 12% wet only, -10 dB @2.9 kHz and -10 dB @5.2 kHz de-clack into a cascaded 5.4 kHz lowpass, +3 dB shelf @10 kHz for finger detail.

reload.rack.notes: Stage 3/3. Both racks come from the pump-action take: rack-01 at 1.18x reads as a rifle charging handle (ar/ak/smg), rack-02 at 0.9x is the heavy bolt for the sniper class.

footstep.dirt.notes: gravel / mud / leaves x2. Walk assets — drive run by playback rate 1.15-1.25 and gain +2 dB. -6 dB @2.3 kHz, -15 dB @3.2 kHz and a cascaded 5 kHz lowpass keep the crunch off the ears.

footstep.metal.notes: Thimras metal_steps 01/07/14/21. -13 dB @2.5 kHz and -9 dB @4.6 kHz take the ring out of the deck plate; 18% wet.

feedback.hitmarker.notes: A 160 ms felt-mallet C6/A5 carrying the cue, with a softened impactPunch at 0.32 underneath for weight. Barely-there but unmistakable; alternate the two so sustained fire doesn't machine-gun one sample.

feedback.headshot.notes: Hitmarker tock + felt-mallet G6/G5 octave — the 'ding' without any metal. 26% wet bloom marks it as special.

feedback.kill.notes: Two-note rising fifth C5->G5 on the felt mallet over a C4 root, 30% wet. Deliberately the only rising-interval sound in the pack: dopamine, no brightness spike.

feedback.damage.notes: impactSoft_heavy at 0.82-0.93x, LP 2.2-2.4 kHz + a 58/66 Hz sine body. You feel it in the chest, it never stings.

grenade.pin.notes: metalLatch + metalClick 90 ms apart, HP 200 Hz, -11 dB @3.4 kHz, -10 dB @6 kHz into a cascaded 5 kHz lowpass.

grenade.throw.notes: swish-8 @0.72x + swish-1 @0.6x, LP 4.2 kHz, 30 ms attack swell — air, not hiss.

grenade.bounce.notes: 01 = dirt (impactSoft + gravel dust), 02 = metal/crate (impactTin + wood). Pitch-vary hard, they repeat fast.

grenade.explosion.near.notes: cannon_01 @0.8x + lowFrequency_explosion @0.68x + explosion1 @0.75x + a 42 Hz sine whump. +8 dB shelf @72 Hz, -17 dB @2.6 kHz, LP 5.2 kHz kills every crackle; a 0.11 air send adds debris dust above 6.5 kHz; 3 s / 50% wet cinematic tail.

grenade.explosion.distant.notes: muffled-distant + cannon_03 @0.7x, LP 1.5 kHz, 68% wet, 3.6 s. Off-screen ordnance you hear in your ribs, not your ears.

medal.kill.notes: Escalating consonant family, all C major: single C5 mallet.

medal.triple.notes: C5-E5-G5 triad arpeggio, a whisper of steel drum enters.

medal.streak.notes: C5-E5-G5-C6-E6 — the top of the ladder. Same chord as every other medal, so stacking them never clashes.

ui.click.notes: click_003 HP'd to 260 Hz under a 130 ms felt G5. Rendered at -20 dBFS: present, never intrusive.

ui.deploy.notes: C5-E5-G5 rising felt arpeggio over a C3 root — the 'you are in' cue.

ui.matchStart.notes: Kenney steel-drum jingle softened (-11 dB @3 kHz, LP 11 kHz) over a C3 root: jungle, but at 3 a.m. volume.

ui.matchEnd.notes: MASHED! sting — steel drum + C3/G3 curtain swell + C5-G5-C6 mallet rise, 2.6 s / 38% wet.

ambience.jungle.notes: 45.000 s seamless stereo bed: BigSoundBank forest-ambience-0100 (85%, cascaded 6.4 kHz lowpass) + cicadas-3002 (22%, cascaded 5.2 kHz lowpass). Built by equal-power tail-into-head crossfade, then rendered twice and the SECOND period kept so every filter is warmed and the period is exactly periodic.

ambience.accent.notes: Sparse one-shots to sprinkle over the bed every 8-25 s: screaming piha, chirp cluster, single cicada. All 22-34% wet and rendered at -18/-18/-20 dBFS so they sit well behind the bed; birds are inherently narrow-band around 2.5-3.5 kHz, which is why they are levelled rather than EQ'd down.
